blocks.text: NEW YORK — Jose Alvarado scored a season-high 21 points, Mikal Bridges had a season-best 19 and the New York Knicks rode a blitz by their bench to a 121-102 victory over the Cleveland Cavaliers on Wednesday night that extended their winning streak to six. Jalen Brunson also scored 19, but the Knicks captain, who was questionable earlier in the day with an illness, labored to a 6-for-22 shooting night and the Knicks fell behind by 11 points multiple times.
